naissance.redrising.test.q1: A dust storm is bearing down on the colony. You have one hour left.
naissance.redrising.test.q1.r1: I brace the walls and nail the shutters.
naissance.redrising.test.q1.r2: I tell everyone where to stand.
naissance.redrising.test.q1.r3: I tend to those who are already hurt.
naissance.redrising.test.q1.r4: I try to understand where it comes from.
naissance.redrising.test.q2: You may keep only one thing, all your life. Which one?
naissance.redrising.test.q3.r3: I ruin them, and no one traces it back to me.
naissance.redrising.test.q3.r4: I leave, far away, without looking back.
naissance.redrising.test.q4: Close your eyes. Where do you feel at home?
naissance.redrising.test.q4.r1: Underground, in the heat of the rock.
naissance.redrising.test.q4.r3: In the heart of a city, in the crowd.
naissance.redrising.test.q4.r4: In the silence of a temple or a laboratory.
naissance.redrising.test.q5: What will they carve on your grave?
naissance.redrising.test.q6: A superior gives you an unjust order.
naissance.redrising.test.q6.r1: I obey. Without order, everything falls apart.
naissance.redrising.test.q6.r2: I pretend to obey, and do something else.
naissance.redrising.test.q7: Sleep won't come. What do you do with your night?
naissance.redrising.test.q7.r2: I make my rounds: everything must be in order.
naissance.redrising.test.q7.r4: I sit with the sick, or I pray.
